Who We Are
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
 The opportunity
 SOAR Engineer is a member of Cyber Platforms Team in an international context of Cyber Defense Center (CDC). The team has to implement and maintain new technologies and tools aimed at security for Worldline’s defense. Develop and update Playbooks to counter latest Threat Scenarios and Attack Methods.
 Day-to-day Responsibilities
Daily operational tasks (change management, application monitoring, application deployment)
Develop automation playbooks using modern SOAR Platforms (e.g.: Swimlane) to support Security Operations, using scripting and programming languages (e.g. Python, PowerShell, JavaScript);
Build new playbooks based on Use Cases and Alerts generated by SIEM and connected systems to match the new shifting of tactics and methods used by attackers;
Be part of the design and architecture of CDC Platforms (e.g. SIEM, EDR, SOAR, VMS);
Continuous Service Improvement for existing technologies and tools, by reviewing Use Cases, Alerts and Correlations and applying Lessons Learned;
 Who Are We Looking For
 We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:
3+ years of experience in DevSecOps.
3+ years of experience in programming languages (e.g. Python, PowerShell).
5+ years of experience in IT Delivery with a minimum of 3+ years of IT Security focus.
Experience working in a DevOps team and a basic understanding of SecOps such as Indicators of Compromise, characterization and forensic engineering of compromised systems, operations security, compliance, mitigation, and analysis through tools that detect advanced threats.
Knowledge of enterprise architecture designs and integrations between multiple systems that are interconnected.
Good knowledge of Security best practices as well as the attack tactics and methods used.
Hands on experience with SOAR technologies, developing and updating playbooks.
Proficiency in English is mandatory.

WFH & Flexible Working Hours
Full access to the “Learning” platform
